ChatSession.title: ChatSession

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a chat session.

sender.description: Indicates who sent the message (e.g., 'user' or 'bot').

content.description: The text content of the message.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to support the Edwin app's chat functionality, focusing on user-specific chat sessions and messages. The primary structure is based on nested collections to maintain a clear ownership and relationship between users, chat sessions, and messages. Each user has their own collection of chat sessions, and each chat session contains its own collection of messages. This approach facilitates secure and efficient data retrieval and management. The use of path-based ownership `/users/{userId}/chatSessions/{chatSessionId}/messages/{messageId}` ensures that each user can only access their own data. Authorization Independence is achieved as there is no need to retrieve parent data to validate access; security rules can directly verify the `request.auth.uid` against the `{userId}` parameter in the path. QAPs are satisfied because list operations are naturally scoped to a user's chat sessions and messages, preventing unauthorized access to other users' data. Homogeneous Security Posture is achieved by ensuring all documents within a collection share the same security requirements, simplifying rules and preventing unintended access.
